# eyemap_T4 reference data (upstream copies)

This directory stores unmodified reference data from the public research repository
[reiserlab/eyemap_T4](https://github.com/reiserlab/eyemap_T4), used in the study
"Eye structure shapes neuron function in Drosophila motion vision".

## Imported files

| Local file | Upstream path | Upstream Git blob SHA |
|---|---|---|
| `neu_Mi1.RData` | `data/neu_Mi1.RData` | `ee941396f53e813b0e12d5a1fcc64abdfec321db` |
| `Mi1_ind.RData` | `data/Mi1_ind.RData` | `bc4933282664a84361c8318d8b4a1d54a728529a` |

Upstream source: https://github.com/reiserlab/eyemap_T4/tree/main/data

## Provenance and licensing

- Upstream repository license file: GNU GPL v3.0. The repository-level license is recorded here as upstream metadata; do not assume it overrides any separate terms applicable to research data.
- The associated Nature article identifies its article content as CC BY-NC 4.0. The precise file-level license/redistribution status of these two RData files is not separately declared in the files themselves.
- These are third-party research data, not original Cortex data. Keep this provenance notice with the files, do not relicense them as Cortex code, and preserve the non-commercial restriction conservatively pending confirmation from the data authors.
- No transformations are intended during import. Git blob SHA verification checks byte-for-byte identity with the upstream objects.

## Intended use

The files are inputs to the Phase 8 Gate 8A inventory script. Their presence does not establish mapping coverage, CATMAID-to-FAFB v783 identity equivalence, or biological validity. Those claims require execution and inspection of the generated inventory.
